name: Aim High Academy Summer Day Camps
description_short: Aim High Academy, a gymnastics and education center in East Greenwich, RI, runs summer day camps with a mix of activities. It also runs week-long (Monday to Friday) gymnastics training camps for girls who do recreational gymnastics, and day camps during school vacations.
